```sql
SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.uuid) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid), 0), 4) AS ruling_intensity
FROM main."cards" c
LEFT JOIN main."rulings" r
  ON c.uuid = r.uuid
  AND r."date" >= '2017-02-01'
  AND r."date" < '2017-03-01'
WHERE c.uuid IN (
  SELECT uuid FROM main."cards"
  WHERE CAST("originalReleaseDate" AS DATE) < '2017-03-01'
);
```
